metadata.title: Searching for stars ejected from the Galactic Centre in DESI

notes: The paper presents a population-level statistical search and non-detection, not an individual-star study. It explicitly focuses on Galactic Centre ejecta still bound to the Galaxy rather than the unbound population (T:p1-b11), and it supplies no individual stellar names or Gaia source identifiers. No identifiable star meets either contribution category.
